source: MLB Stats API · regular season only

2015.source_name: MLB Stats API regular-season team statistics
2015.source_note: Overall sorts by run differential per game; Batting by OPS; Pitching by ERA (lower is better). OPS is OBP + SLG from the source’s rounded rates. SD compares each team with the unweighted mean of eligible teams in that season; positive is better. Ties share a rank. No opponent, ballpark, recency, fielding or baserunning adjustment. Postseason games are excluded. Supporting columns do not change the default ranking.
